item.title: On Watching Films Alone
item.description: I watch a lot of films... not as much as I wish but a good amount to say that I think it's so much more enjoyable watching movies alone in the theatre. you can really immerse in the filmmakers world, since you don't have to worry about making comments to your friends next to you.
